description:
Refurbishment of 1st floor to include;
1.) New Works: Previous infilled doorway reopened and FD30 fire door installed.
2.) New Works: Power and water services provision extended and capped to provide future proofing option for additional tea point.
3.) Strip out: Modern WC sanitary ware and vanity unit.
4.) New Works: Replacement WC and new vanity unit in same configuration as previous. Addition of ambulant disabled WC accessories and grab rails.
5.) Strip out: Non-fire rated modern tea point partitions, suspended ceiling, asbestos removal from ceiling void, former modern tea point, former modern WC cubicle and sliding door.
6.) New Works: Partitions and doors reinstated with 30 minute fire rating, fire rated plasterboard ceiling and coving to match existing. Former tea point to become a small lobby/ cloakroom. WC cubicle to be extended into former lobby space and basin replaced with larger vanity unit. 
7.) New Works: Tea point located below rear office window. Spec: Clarkenwell Dove Grey with Calcutta White 38mm Worktop and matching backboard and including basin, 2no double sockets, integrated fridge and dishwasher
8.) Remove redundant services and related fixtures including telecoms cabling, boiler, radiators, damaged trunking, light fixtures.
9.) Upgraded services including LED light fittings, replacement cable trunking, AC installation [Applied for under listed building and planning application numbers 25/03638/LBC and 25/0367/FULL]
10.) Redecoration of ceilings, walls, windows, fireplace surrounds, joinery, like-for-like to match existing finishes.
11.) Doors throughout replaced with FD30 fire doors with detailing to match previous panelled appearance
12.) Installation of new floor finish [Kardean 'Croftmore Oak VJW8240']
